api/src/core/__init__.py.name: Core foundations
api/src/core/__init__.py.description: Provides the shared groundwork every other part of the server builds on, such as record access and saved copies.

api/src/core/app_wiring.py.name: Startup wiring
api/src/core/app_wiring.py.description: Hooks the shared checks and error handling into the main app so every request behaves the same way.

api/src/core/auth.py.name: Sign-in checks
api/src/core/auth.py.description: Identifies who is making each request, refuses anyone not signed in, and respects who is being impersonated.

api/src/core/cache/__init__.py.name: Saved copies
api/src/core/cache/__init__.py.description: Gives the rest of the server one shared way to keep and fetch saved copies so screens load faster.

api/src/core/cache/data_provider_cache.p.name: Lookup result copies
api/src/core/cache/data_provider_cache.p.description: Keeps recent data-provider results per workflow so repeat lookups answer instantly instead of calling the outside service again.

api/src/core/cache/invalidation.py.name: Clearing stale copies
api/src/core/cache/invalidation.py.description: Clears or refreshes saved copies the moment a form, role, organization or setting changes, so nobody sees out-of-date information.

api/src/core/cache/keys.py.name: Saved-copy labels
api/src/core/cache/keys.py.description: Names each saved copy by organization and record so the right one is found, replaced or cleared.

api/src/core/cache/redis_client.py.name: Shared saved-copy connection
api/src/core/cache/redis_client.py.description: Opens and shares the connection to the fast in-memory store that holds saved copies and live updates.

api/src/core/constants.py.name: Platform constants
api/src/core/constants.py.description: Holds the fixed internal identifiers every part of the platform agrees on, such as the built-in organization and user.

api/src/core/csrf.py.name: Cross-site request guard
api/src/core/csrf.py.description: Blocks other websites from quietly acting as a signed-in staff member by checking where each change came from.

api/src/core/database_retry.py.name: Database outage retries
api/src/core/database_retry.py.description: Retries a short piece of work when the database is briefly unavailable, so a momentary hiccup does not fail a save or a run.

api/src/core/database.py.name: Database connections
api/src/core/database.py.description: Opens and reuses the connections to the database where all records live, including separate ones for handing out work.

api/src/core/db_deps.py.name: Per-request database access
api/src/core/db_deps.py.description: Hands each incoming request its own connection to the records and closes it when the request finishes.

api/src/core/embed_middleware.py.name: Embedded screen limits
api/src/core/embed_middleware.py.description: Limits what a screen embedded in another website can ask for, allowing only the specific actions it was granted.

api/src/core/error_messages.py.name: Readable error text
api/src/core/error_messages.py.description: Turns an unexpected failure into a clear, steady message the screens can show instead of a blank error.

api/src/core/exceptions.py.name: Refusal error
api/src/core/exceptions.py.description: Defines the standard refusal raised when someone asks for a record they are not allowed to see.

api/src/core/locks.py.name: One-at-a-time locks
api/src/core/locks.py.description: Stops two parts of the platform doing the same sensitive job at once, such as an import or a deploy, by giving one the turn.

api/src/core/log_safety.py.name: Safe log text
api/src/core/log_safety.py.description: Cleans names and values typed by people before they reach the logs, so nobody can slip fake entries in.

api/src/core/malloc.py.name: Releasing spare memory
api/src/core/malloc.py.description: Gives unused memory back to the operating system after large jobs finish, keeping the server lean.

api/src/core/metrics.py.name: Daily usage totals
api/src/core/metrics.py.description: Adds up runs, time saved and spend each day so the dashboard and savings report have current numbers.

api/src/core/module_cache_contract.py.name: Saved-code naming
api/src/core/module_cache_contract.py.description: Defines the labels and stored shape used to keep copies of workflow code, shared by every part that reads them.

api/src/core/module_cache_sync.py.name: Saved-code loader
api/src/core/module_cache_sync.py.description: Finds and loads the code a run needs from saved copies or file storage, without a round trip to the main server.

api/src/core/module_cache.py.name: Workflow code copies
api/src/core/module_cache.py.description: Keeps recent copies of workflow code and its lookup details so runs start quickly and edits take effect at once.

api/src/core/org_filter.py.name: Organization record filters
api/src/core/org_filter.py.description: Narrows a search to the organizations a person may see, so no list ever shows another customer's records.

api/src/core/paths.py.name: Temporary folders
api/src/core/paths.py.description: Creates isolated scratch folders for uploads and one-off jobs so they cannot interfere with each other.

api/src/core/principal.py.name: Signed-in caller
api/src/core/principal.py.description: Carries who is calling — a person, a service account or an embedded screen — so records and reports are attributed correctly.

api/src/core/pubsub.py.name: Live updates
api/src/core/pubsub.py.description: Pushes run progress, log lines, chat messages and notifications to open screens the instant something changes.

api/src/core/rate_limit.py.name: Sign-in attempt limits
api/src/core/rate_limit.py.description: Caps how often someone can try to sign in, so password guessing is slowed down and spotted.

api/src/core/redis_client.py.name: Run handover state
api/src/core/redis_client.py.description: Tracks runs that have been handed to another process and how each finished, so nothing is lost in between.

api/src/core/redis_reconnect.py.name: Live update reconnects
api/src/core/redis_reconnect.py.description: Reconnects the live-update feed automatically after a network blip so open screens keep receiving changes.

api/src/core/repo_dirty.py.name: Unsaved workspace flag
api/src/core/repo_dirty.py.description: Remembers that the workspace has platform edits not yet copied to GitHub, so people can be warned before changes are lost.

api/src/core/request_actor.py.name: Who did it
api/src/core/request_actor.py.description: Records which person, assistant or connected tool caused a change so the history shows a real name.

api/src/core/request_body_limit.py.name: Upload size cap
api/src/core/request_body_limit.py.description: Rejects oversized uploads before they are read in full, protecting the server from being swamped.

api/src/core/request_context.py.name: Per-request identity
api/src/core/request_context.py.description: Remembers who is signed in and which watch session a request belongs to while it is being handled.

api/src/core/requirements_cache.py.name: Installed package list
api/src/core/requirements_cache.py.description: Keeps the list of extra packages workflows rely on, plus a saved copy, so installs survive restarts.

api/src/core/s3_transport.py.name: Cloud file storage link
api/src/core/s3_transport.py.description: Talks to the cloud file storage that holds uploads, generated documents and exports, with retries and clear errors.

api/src/core/secret_naming.py.name: Secret name rules
api/src/core/secret_naming.py.description: Gives every stored service password a predictable, unique name and checks that typed names are valid.

api/src/core/secret_string.py.name: Masked secrets
api/src/core/secret_string.py.description: Keeps passwords and keys out of logs and error messages by hiding them wherever they would be printed.

api/src/core/security.py.name: Passwords and sign-in passes
api/src/core/security.py.description: Hashes passwords, issues and checks sign-in passes, and encrypts stored secrets such as connection passwords.

GET /items.name: Records connection check
GET /items.description: Answers a short sample request used to confirm the server can reach the records.

POST /auth/login.name: Staff sign-in
POST /auth/login.description: Signs a staff member in with their email and password, and slows repeated failed attempts.
